description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art head, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: put the same hat on both heads, sitting straight and a little loose, its band resting just above the ears and a little wider than the head: a light-brown leather cowboy hat with a tall dented crown, a darker band, and a wide brim curled up at the sides drawn as a thick solid band at least three pixels deep, not a thin line (seen from behind, the back of the light-brown cowboy hat, its wide thick brim curled up at the sides). Simple bold shapes. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The head, the face and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
